topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I couldn't help but stand a little taller when I saw the look on their face. It was as if the memory of our days, woven through the years, had found its way back to them, if only for a moment. I didn't need to explain; the weight of our shared past was enough. We walked in silence, but it wasn't the sort that fills the spaces between strangers. This was a silence that holds stories, a silence that speaks volumes. It was clear, in the way they walked beside me, that something had shifted. We were no longer just two people who happened to meet. We were more. Much more.
